# Offline decisions recordings

`success.json` is a sanitized recording of the documented example response at
[OpenRouter's alpha decisions reference](https://openrouter.ai/docs/api/api-reference/alphadecisions/submit-a-decisions-request),
retrieved 2026-10-08. The generated request identifier/provider field are omitted.
It is documentation evidence, not a live measurement of the configured candidate.
`fallback.json` is a synthetic transformation to the internal strict-schema format.
All evidence in tests is synthetic. No live inference call, credential or tenant
content was captured. Model-version strings reflect the example, not a model default.
